parthenon.name: Parthenon
parthenon.price_text: €20 summer Acropolis ticket (≈€10 low season) · includes slopes
parthenon.hours: Daily, roughly 08:00–20:00 in summer · shorter in winter, check on the day
parthenon.tip: Go at opening time to beat heat and crowds. Bring water and wear shoes with grip on the marble.
parthenon.best: First hour after opening, spring or autumn

acropolis-museum.name: Acropolis Museum
acropolis-museum.hours: Mon–Thu and Sat–Sun roughly 09:00–17:00, Fri until 22:00 in summer · check on the day
acropolis-museum.tip: Do the museum before the hill. The top floor has the Parthenon frieze with a view up to the temple.
acropolis-museum.best: Late afternoon or the Friday evening opening

plaka.name: Plaka
plaka.hours: Always open · shops and tavernas run late
plaka.tip: Wander the small lanes uphill from Adrianou street. Eat one street back from the main tourist strip.
plaka.best: Evening, or early morning before the heat

ancient-agora.name: Ancient Agora of Athens
ancient-agora.hours: Daily, roughly 08:00–20:00 summer · shorter in winter, check on the day
ancient-agora.tip: The rebuilt Stoa of Attalos holds a small museum and shade. Combine with the Acropolis ticket if it is offered.

temple-olympian-zeus.name: Temple of Olympian Zeus
temple-olympian-zeus.hours: Daily, roughly 08:00–20:00 summer · shorter in winter, check on the day
temple-olympian-zeus.tip: The surviving columns are huge. Best seen in soft light; there is little shade.

syntagma-square.name: Syntagma Square
syntagma-square.hours: Always open · changing of the guard on the hour
syntagma-square.tip: Watch the Evzones guard change at the Tomb of the Unknown Soldier, then walk down to Plaka.
syntagma-square.best: On the hour, any time of day

panathenaic-stadium.name: Panathenaic Stadium
panathenaic-stadium.hours: Daily, roughly 08:00–19:00 · check on the day
panathenaic-stadium.tip: Climb to the top row for the view. The marble seats get very hot at midday.

allou-fun-park.name: Allou Fun Park
allou-fun-park.price_text: Pay per ride or buy a pass · check prices on the day
allou-fun-park.hours: Mostly afternoons and evenings · seasonal, check on the day
allou-fun-park.tip: A big family amusement park west of the centre. Allow half a day and check opening days before you go.

athens-lions-kiddie-carnival.name: Athens Lions Club Kiddie Carnival
athens-lions-kiddie-carnival.hours: Seasonal event · check dates on the day
athens-lions-kiddie-carnival.tip: This is a seasonal children's carnival, not a year-round attraction. Confirm dates and location before planning around it.

erechtheion.name: Erechtheion
erechtheion.hours: Same as the Acropolis · check on the day
erechtheion.tip: Look for the Caryatid porch on the north side. The originals are in the Acropolis Museum.

hadrians-arch.name: Hadrian's Arch
hadrians-arch.tip: A quick photo stop on the walk between Plaka and the Temple of Olympian Zeus.

karaiskakis-stadium.name: Karaiskakis Stadium
karaiskakis-stadium.price_text: Match tickets vary · check the club site
karaiskakis-stadium.tip: Home of Olympiacos. Football nights here are loud and intense; buy tickets in advance.

lycabettus-hill.name: Lycabettus Hill
lycabettus-hill.price_text: Free to walk · funicular costs extra
lycabettus-hill.hours: Hill always open · funicular runs daytime into evening, check on the day
lycabettus-hill.tip: Best sunset view over the city and the Acropolis. Walk up or take the funicular.

monastiraki-square.name: Monastiraki Square
monastiraki-square.hours: Always open · flea market busiest on Sundays
monastiraki-square.tip: Come on a Sunday morning for the flea market. Watch your bag in the crowds.

moussaka.name: Moussaka in a taverna
moussaka.price_text: ≈€10–16 a portion in a Plaka taverna
moussaka.hours: Lunch and dinner, typically from 12:00 to late
moussaka.tip: Order it hot from the oven, not reheated. Pair with a simple village salad.

national-archaeological-museum.name: National Archaeological Museum
national-archaeological-museum.hours: Roughly 08:00–20:00, hours vary by day and season · check on the day
national-archaeological-museum.tip: The best collection of Greek antiquities in the world. Give it at least two hours and go early.

odeon-herodes-atticus.name: Odeon of Herodes Atticus
odeon-herodes-atticus.price_text: Concert tickets vary · check the Athens Festival programme
odeon-herodes-atticus.tip: See a concert under the stars if you can. Otherwise view it from above on the Acropolis path.

roman-agora.name: Roman Agora of Athens
roman-agora.hours: Daily, roughly 08:00–20:00 summer · check on the day
roman-agora.tip: Small and quick. The Tower of the Winds is the highlight.

theatre-dionysus.name: Theatre of Dionysus
theatre-dionysus.hours: Same as the Acropolis · check on the day
theatre-dionysus.tip: The birthplace of theatre. See it on the way up or down the Acropolis slope.

university-trilogy.name: University of Athens Trilogy
university-trilogy.tip: Three grand neoclassical buildings on Panepistimiou street. A short photo stop on the walk to Omonia.

university-georgia.name: University of Georgia (Athens, USA)
university-georgia.price_text: Not in Athens, Greece · check locally
university-georgia.tip: This is a university in Georgia, USA, not a place in Athens, Greece. Skip it for this trip.

zaxbys.name: Zaxby's
zaxbys.price_text: US fast-food chain · not in Athens, Greece
zaxbys.tip: A US chicken chain with no Athens, Greece branch. Ignore it and eat at a local taverna instead.

central-market.name: Varvakios Central Market
central-market.price_text: Free to enter · pay for what you eat
central-market.hours: Mon–Sat mornings to early afternoon · closed Sunday
central-market.tip: Come before noon for the fish and meat halls. Grab a cheap lunch at the tavernas inside.

philopappou-viewpoint.name: Philopappou Hill viewpoint
philopappou-viewpoint.hours: Always open · avoid after dark alone
philopappou-viewpoint.tip: The best free view of the Acropolis. Walk up from Koukaki in the late afternoon.

food-tour.name: Athens street food walking tour
food-tour.tip: Book a small-group tour to taste souvlaki, pies and sweets. Check that tastings are included in the price.

anafiotika-walk.name: Anafiotika neighbourhood walk
anafiotika-walk.tip: Whitewashed island-style houses under the Acropolis. Keep quiet, people live here.

souvlaki-stop.name: Souvlaki at a Monastiraki grill
souvlaki-stop.tip: Cheapest good meal in the centre. Order pork or chicken with tzatziki and eat it standing.

koukaki-evening-walk.name: Koukaki evening walk
koukaki-evening-walk.tip: A local neighbourhood with good bars and tavernas away from the tourist strip. Walk it after dinner.
